keywords: Typography, Design Tokens, CSS Architecture, Mixins

question.t: 您的團隊目前將字體屬性拆分為獨立的 Tokens（如字體大小、字重、行高），但在 Code Review 中發現開發者經常隨意組合這些 Tokens，導致視覺不一致。
question.en: Your team currently splits typography properties into independent Tokens (e.g., font size, weight, line height), but during Code Reviews, you notice developers often mix and match these Tokens arbitrarily, leading to visual inconsistencies.

question.t: 為了改善這種情況並強制執行設計規範，下列哪一種重構策略最為合適？
question.en: To improve this situation and enforce design guidelines, which of the following refactoring strategies is most appropriate?

options.t: (A) 移除所有字體相關的 Tokens，要求開發者直接使用 Figma 中的 pixel 值以確保精確度。
options.en: (A) Remove all typography-related Tokens and require developers to use pixel values directly from Figma to ensure precision.

options.t: (B) 建立「複合式 Token (Composite Tokens)」或 CSS Utility Classes（如 `.text-heading-lg`），將大小、行高與字重封裝成一組不可分割的樣式。
options.en: (B) Create "Composite Tokens" or CSS Utility Classes (e.g., `.text-heading-lg`) that encapsulate size, line-height, and weight into a single indivisible style set.

options.t: (C) 為每個 HTML 標籤（h1, h2, p）設定全域樣式，並禁止在元件層級覆寫任何字體屬性。
options.en: (C) Set global styles for every HTML tag (h1, h2, p) and forbid overriding any typography properties at the component level.

options.t: (D) 使用 JavaScript 在 Runtime 檢查所有元素的 computed style，若不符合規範則拋出錯誤。
options.en: (D) Use JavaScript to check the computed style of all elements at runtime and throw an error if they do not comply with the guidelines.

why.t: 字體排印（Typography）通常需要成套定義（Size, Line-height, Weight, Letter-spacing）才能確保最佳閱讀體驗。將其封裝為複合式 Token 或 Utility Class 可以避免開發者漏寫屬性或錯誤搭配，這是 Design System 中常見的最佳實務。
why.en: Typography usually needs to be defined as a set (Size, Line-height, Weight, Letter-spacing) to ensure the best reading experience. Encapsulating them into Composite Tokens or Utility Classes prevents developers from missing properties or making incorrect combinations, which is a common best practice in Design Systems.

question.t: 在定義 Design Tokens 的命名規範時，您希望避免「過於特定」導致難以重用，同時也要避免「過於籠統」導致缺乏語意。
question.en: When defining naming conventions for Design Tokens, you want to avoid being "too specific," which makes reuse difficult, while also avoiding being "too broad," which leads to a lack of semantics.

question.t: 下列哪一個 Token 命名最符合 Semantic Layer 的最佳實務（Category-Type-Item 結構）？
question.en: Which of the following Token names best aligns with the best practices of the Semantic Layer (Category-Type-Item structure)?

options.t: (A) `--color-blue-500`
options.en: (A) `--color-blue-500`

options.t: (B) `--color-sidebar-bottom-border`
options.en: (B) `--color-sidebar-bottom-border`

options.t: (C) `--border-color-subtle`
options.en: (C) `--border-color-subtle`

options.t: (D) `--hex-E5E7EB`
options.en: (D) `--hex-E5E7EB`

why.t: 選項 (C) `--border-color-subtle` 清楚描述了屬性類別 (Border Color) 與意圖 (Subtle)，具有良好的語意且不綁定特定元件位置，易於在不同元件間重用。選項 (A) 是 Primitive Token，(B) 過於特定（綁定 Sidebar），(D) 則是完全沒有抽象化的命名。
why.en: Option (C) `--border-color-subtle` clearly describes the property category (Border Color) and intent (Subtle). It has good semantics and is not tied to a specific component location, making it easy to reuse across different components. Option (A) is a Primitive Token, (B) is too specific (tied to Sidebar), and (D) has no abstraction at all.

keywords: CSS Variables, Scope, Theming, Local Override

question.t: 您的應用程式支援全域的深色模式（Dark Mode）。現在產品需求新增一個「Pro 會員專區」區塊，要求該區塊無論在深色或淺色模式下，都必須強制呈現「深色主題」的樣式。
question.en: Your application supports global Dark Mode. A new product requirement adds a "Pro Member Section" that must strictly display in "Dark Theme" style regardless of whether the app is in light or dark mode.

question.t: 基於上述 CSS 變數架構，最簡潔且高效的實作方式為何？
question.en: Based on the CSS variable architecture above, what is the most concise and efficient implementation?

options.t: (A) 為該區塊內的所有元件複製一份新的 CSS class，例如 `.card-pro`，並手動填入深色色碼。
options.en: (A) Duplicate CSS classes for all components within that section, e.g., `.card-pro`, and manually fill in the dark color codes.

options.t: (B) 在該區塊的容器元素上加上 `data-theme="dark"` 屬性，利用 CSS 變數的繼承特性自動覆蓋值。
options.en: (B) Add the `data-theme="dark"` attribute to the container element of that section, utilizing the inheritance property of CSS variables to automatically override values.

options.t: (C) 使用 JavaScript 監聽該區塊的渲染，並透過 `element.style.setProperty` 逐一修改所有子元素的變數。
options.en: (C) Use JavaScript to observe the rendering of that section and modify variables for all child elements one by one via `element.style.setProperty`.

options.t: (D) 使用 `!important` 強制覆寫全域的 `:root` 變數設定。
options.en: (D) Use `!important` to forcibly override the global `:root` variable settings.

why.t: CSS Custom Properties 具有作用域（Scope）與繼承特性。只要在特定容器上重新定義變數（透過 `[data-theme="dark"]` 選擇器），該容器內的所有子元件就會自動使用新的變數值，無需修改元件本身的 CSS 或使用 JavaScript。
why.en: CSS Custom Properties have scope and inheritance characteristics. By simply redefining the variables on a specific container (via the `[data-theme="dark"]` selector), all child components within that container will automatically use the new variable values without needing to modify the component CSS or use JavaScript.

keywords: Deprecation Strategy, DesignOps, Refactoring, Breaking Changes

question.t: 作為 Design System 的維護者，您決定將一個命名不佳的 Token `--color-danger` 更名為 `--color-support-error`。
question.en: As a Design System maintainer, you decide to rename a poorly named token `--color-danger` to `--color-support-error`.

question.t: 為了避免對數十個下游專案造成「破壞性變更 (Breaking Change)」，下列哪一個遷移策略最為穩健？
question.en: To avoid causing a "Breaking Change" to dozens of downstream projects, which of the following migration strategies is the most robust?

options.t: (A) 直接在下一版套件中移除舊 Token，並在 Release Notes 中要求大家升級時執行全域取代。
options.en: (A) Remove the old token directly in the next package version and require everyone to perform a global replace when upgrading in the Release Notes.

options.t: (B) 保留舊 Token `--color-danger`，並將其值指向新 Token (`var(--color-support-error)`)，同時在 Build Time 加入警告訊息，設定日落期 (Sunset Period)。
options.en: (B) Keep the old token `--color-danger`, point its value to the new token (`var(--color-support-error)`), add a warning message at Build Time, and set a Sunset Period.

options.t: (C) 建立一個全新的 npm package 發布新版 Design System，舊版 package 停止維護。
options.en: (C) Create a brand new npm package to publish the new Design System, and stop maintaining the old package.

options.t: (D) 使用 JavaScript 在 Runtime 偵測是否有人使用舊 Token，如果有則自動替換成新 Token。
options.en: (D) Use JavaScript to detect at Runtime if anyone is using the old token, and automatically replace it with the new token if found.

why.t: 選項 (B) 提供了向後相容性 (Backward Compatibility)。透過 Alias 機制，現有程式碼不會壞掉，而 Build Time 的警告能提醒開發者在未來的時間點前完成遷移。這是管理大型系統 API 變更的標準做法。
why.en: Option (B) provides Backward Compatibility. Through the Alias mechanism, existing code won't break, while Build Time warnings remind developers to complete the migration before a future date. This is the standard practice for managing API changes in large systems.

keywords: CSS-in-JS, Performance, Hybrid Architecture, Styled Components

question.t: 在使用 CSS-in-JS 函式庫（如 Styled Components 或 Emotion）實作 Design System 時，許多資深團隊傾向採用「混合架構」：使用 CSS Variables 定義 Tokens，而非完全依賴 JS 的 Theme Provider 插值 (Interpolation)。
question.en: When implementing a Design System using CSS-in-JS libraries (like Styled Components or Emotion), many senior teams prefer a "Hybrid Architecture": using CSS Variables to define Tokens instead of relying entirely on JS Theme Provider interpolation.

question.t: 採用選項 B (CSS Variables) 的主要優勢為何？
question.en: What is the primary advantage of adopting Option B (CSS Variables)?

options.t: (A) CSS Variables 提供更強的 TypeScript 型別檢查支援。
options.en: (A) CSS Variables provide stronger TypeScript type checking support.

options.t: (B) 避免了當主題切換時，JS 需要重新計算並產生大量新的 CSS class 字串注入 DOM，提升 Runtime 效能。
options.en: (B) It avoids the need for JS to recalculate and generate a large number of new CSS class strings to inject into the DOM when the theme switches, improving Runtime performance.

options.t: (C) CSS Variables 可以防止樣式被瀏覽器快取，確保使用者總是看到最新設計。
options.en: (C) CSS Variables prevent styles from being cached by the browser, ensuring users always see the latest design.

options.t: (D) CSS Variables 允許在 CSS 中使用邏輯判斷（如 if/else）。
options.en: (D) CSS Variables allow the use of logic (like if/else) within CSS.

why.t: CSS-in-JS 的插值方式在主題切換時，需要重新執行所有元件的 Template Literal 函式，並產生新的 CSS class hash，這會造成顯著的 Scripting 與 Rendering 負擔。CSS Variables 則由瀏覽器引擎原生處理，切換主題只是改變變數值，複雜度為 O(1)，不會觸發 React 的 re-render 或 style injection。
why.en: Interpolation in CSS-in-JS requires re-executing the Template Literal functions for all components and generating new CSS class hashes when the theme changes, causing significant Scripting and Rendering overhead. CSS Variables are handled natively by the browser engine; switching themes only changes variable values, which is O(1) complexity and does not trigger React re-renders or style injection.

keywords: Semantic Layer, Coupling, Intent vs Value, Code Review

question.t: 您在 Code Review 時發現上述程式碼。雖然目前的視覺效果是正確的（邊框和文字都是藍色），但您認為這是一個潛在的 Bug。
question.en: You encounter the code above during a Code Review. Although the current visual result is correct (both border and text are blue), you consider this a potential bug.

question.t: 為什麼這種做法違反了 Design Tokens 的使用原則？
question.en: Why does this approach violate the principles of using Design Tokens?

options.t: (A) 因為 `--color-text-link` 的命名太長，會增加 CSS 檔案的大小。
options.en: (A) Because the name `--color-text-link` is too long, it will increase the CSS file size.

options.t: (B) 這建立了錯誤的語意耦合（Semantic Coupling）。若未來設計決定將「連結」改為有底線樣式或不同顏色，按鈕邊框也會意外被影響。
options.en: (B) This creates incorrect Semantic Coupling. If the design decides to change "links" to an underlined style or a different color in the future, the button border will be unintentionally affected.

options.t: (C) 瀏覽器無法將文字顏色的變數應用在邊框屬性上，這會導致渲染錯誤。
options.en: (C) Browsers cannot apply text color variables to border properties; this will cause rendering errors.

options.t: (D) 應該直接使用 Primitive Token（如 `--blue-500`）來確保兩者顏色永遠一致。
options.en: (D) You should use the Primitive Token (e.g., `--blue-500`) directly to ensure both colors always stay consistent.

why.t: Design Tokens 的核心價值在於「意圖（Intent）」而非「數值（Value）」。雖然現在數值相同，但「連結文字」與「按鈕邊框」是兩個不同的語意概念。混合使用會導致未來維護困難，這被稱為隱性耦合（Implicit Coupling）。
why.en: The core value of Design Tokens lies in "Intent" rather than "Value." Although the values are currently the same, "link text" and "button border" are two different semantic concepts. Mixing them leads to maintenance difficulties in the future, known as Implicit Coupling.

keywords: Style Dictionary, Cross-platform, Build Pipeline, Automation

question.t: 您的公司使用 Style Dictionary 來管理跨平台 Tokens。iOS 團隊回報他們無法使用生成的 JSON 檔案，因為 iOS 開發環境需要特定的 `.swift` 結構或 Color Assets。
question.en: Your company uses Style Dictionary to manage cross-platform Tokens. The iOS team reports they cannot use the generated JSON files because the iOS development environment requires specific `.swift` structures or Color Assets.

question.t: 在 DesignOps 流程中，這屬於哪一個階段的職責？
question.en: In the DesignOps process, which stage is responsible for this?

options.t: (A) Extraction (萃取)：Figma Plugin 匯出時發生錯誤。
options.en: (A) Extraction: An error occurred during the Figma Plugin export.

options.t: (B) Transformation (轉換)：未針對 iOS 平台設定正確的 Format 與 Transform Config。
options.en: (B) Transformation: The correct Format and Transform Config were not set for the iOS platform.

options.t: (C) Consumption (消費)：iOS 工程師應該手動解析 JSON 檔案。
options.en: (C) Consumption: iOS engineers should manually parse the JSON file.

options.t: (D) Definition (定義)：Token 的命名不符合 iOS 的命名規範。
options.en: (D) Definition: The token naming does not comply with iOS naming conventions.

why.t: Style Dictionary 的核心功能就是「轉換（Transformation）」。它讀取通用的 Token JSON（Source of Truth），並根據設定檔將其轉換為各平台原生的格式（如 Web 的 CSS, iOS 的 Swift/Objective-C, Android 的 XML）。若 iOS 團隊拿到的是原始 JSON，代表 Build Pipeline 中的轉換設定有誤。
why.en: The core function of Style Dictionary is "Transformation." It reads the generic Token JSON (Source of Truth) and converts it into platform-native formats based on the configuration (e.g., CSS for Web, Swift/Objective-C for iOS, XML for Android). If the iOS team received raw JSON, it means the transformation configuration in the Build Pipeline is incorrect.
